title: Sub-Scope Index
summary: make docs_subscope the generic collection index for configured sub-scopes with a shared public reader and explicit manage-only capabilities
content_html:
Sub-Scope Index

Result

A configured one-level Docs Viewer sub-scope can use docs_subscope as its canonical collection index without adding its documents to the parent scope's Index, Recent, global search, or scope selector.

The shared report retains public list/detail navigation and subdoc URL state. Manage mode may contribute a deliberate subset of the main Index capabilities, including document-state icons, collection-local checkbox selection, selection-backed actions, and validated detail-document controls.

The Analysis tags collection is the first substantial consumer and review surface. The feature itself is generic and contains no Tag Registry behavior.

Why This Is A Separate Feature

Tag-document linking owns creation-time association between one tag registry record and one independently managed document. It does not own later document navigation, selection, deletion, package export, or other collection management.

Manage Sub-Scope Documents delivered explicit-target source and metadata editing for a displayed sub-scope document. This feature starts from that shipped boundary and gives the collection itself a coherent generic index and action model.

Feature Documents

  • Independent Canonical Documents — concept for one-time seeding, independent canonical ownership, tolerant cross-application references, and the absence of ongoing synchronization.
  • Sub-Scope Index Architecture — proposed collection identity, shared/public projection, manage-only contributions, selection lifecycle, and function-adoption boundary.

Delivery Order

order delivery classification complete outcome
1 Sub-Scope Report Contribution Delivery extension and behavior-preserving refactor move manage-only row semantics behind an optional report contribution contract and expose list/detail control hosts without changing public behavior
2 Sub-Scope Detail Delete Delivery new sub-scope action using an extended existing mutation family delete exactly the validated displayed sub-scope document from the detail header
3 Sub-Scope Package Preparation Delivery new sub-scope selection UI plus selection/package refactor and extension select exact collection documents and prepare an explicitly export-only package
4 Sub-Scope Report List Filter Delivery shared report extension filter already loaded collection records without adding a search index, endpoint, or full-text behavior

SSI-1 and SSI-2 are delivered. Exact child preview/apply, confined rebuilding, capability-aware confirmation, local exact-row reconciliation, replacement-history repair, recovery refetch, and destructive route isolation are shipped. SSI-3 remains proposed and has not started. The remaining order is deliberate: SSI-2 proves one small exact-target workflow and reconciliation path before SSI-3 adds broader list selection and package-service adoption.

Selection is not a separate delivery from Prepare Package. Checkboxes without an available selection action would be an incomplete user outcome.

Shipped Baseline

  • docs_subscope owns manifest/inventory-ordered list state, subdoc navigation, validated detail loading, and embedded detail rendering.
  • Public mode reads the minimal public manifest.
  • Manage mode reads a compact local inventory containing doc_id, title, ui_status, and viewable.
  • The existing Status and non-viewable icons already render from that local inventory.
  • The shared report accepts optional row, list-toolbar, and validated detail-toolbar contributions plus collection-scoped mount, state, refresh, and unmount notifications.
  • One manage-only contribution owns Status/non-viewable row presentation; public routes provide no contribution and import no management module.
  • The management host can edit source and metadata using an exact { scope, sub_scope, doc_id } target.
  • A validated displayed child can be previewed and deleted by that same exact target. Success runs only the confined child builder, removes the exact row from the loaded report inventory, clears subdoc with replacement history, and does not reload parent discovery payloads.
  • Sub-scope documents remain independently canonical and excluded from the parent scope's main discovery payloads.

Boundary

In scope:

  • treating docs_subscope as a collection index rather than a tag-specific report;
  • one collection identity shared by browser state and applicable services;
  • optional manage-only list and detail control contributions;
  • collection-local checkbox selection with checked IDs as the only selection action target;
  • explicit adoption by functions that can truthfully operate on a sub-scope collection or document;
  • unchanged public read-only behavior and management-module isolation; and
  • focused delivery slices for validated detail deletion and sub-scope package export after the architecture is accepted.

Not in scope:

  • Tag Registry creation, editing, deletion, association repair, or synchronization;
  • making sub-scopes top-level selectable scopes;
  • merging sub-scope documents into the parent Index, Recent, or global search;
  • making every scope-level function automatically accept a sub-scope;
  • turning all report types into workflow hosts;
  • public management controls or local service access; or
  • returned-package review/import without a separately complete sub-scope contract.

Deferred Decisions

SSI-4 list filtering, overall-search adoption, general responsive refinement, bulk deletion, and further function adoption are not completion criteria for SSI-2 or SSI-3.

If search later adopts sub-scope documents, they should join the overall Docs Viewer search surface. This feature will not add a sub-scope-specific search index or parallel search UI.
